description: Iteration 21 hand-read image marks for the '#17 Shovel' recording (references/shots/shovel-17-screen-recording.mov). Pixel coordinates are in the decoded, display-rotated recording frame (2556 x 1180 px, u right, v down). Only segment 1 (full speed, camera 'seg1') is calibrated. Every mark was read on a gridded crop of the named recording frame; uncertainty_px is the reading uncertainty (blur, occlusion), not a model error. Status of every mark: traced.
read_by: AI (iteration 21, 2026-10-04), not reviewed by the user

camera_correspondences.note: Ice-plane points identifiable in both the canonical geometry (world mm, z = 0) and segment-1 recording frame 167 (2.780 s, no motion). World positions come from the reference overhead landmarks through map.overhead.preview (assumed similarity) or from red faceoff-dot centroids measured in the reference overhead (overhead_px). The recorded table is a different STIGA edition (sponsor artwork differs); identical line/slot layout is an assumption checked only by the fit residuals.
